events.feedback:
Yes. The Suriname Stickpea record has **excellent raw material**, but I would revise it fairly aggressively before letting it become a model for the HTML. The biggest opportunity is to make the plant feel **alive and discoverable**, while tightening a few claims that are currently more confident than the evidence appears to warrant.

## My overall editorial verdict

**Keep the plant. Keep most of the research. Change the emphasis.**

Right now the record is roughly:

> beautiful flower → botany → horticulture → wildlife → propagation

I'd make the visitor story:

> **A pink powderpuff that isn't really a flower → hummingbirds and butterflies → ants secretly defending the plant → leaves that go to sleep → seed pods that launch their offspring → why it is called Suriname Stickpea → how to distinguish it from Red Powderpuff → what this nonnative means at Palma Sola.**

That has much more personality.
